question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**within**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage contrasts outward appearance with inner qualities.
 
• It highlights that true beauty and kindness come from the inside.
 
• "**Within**" fits the context perfectly, as it emphasizes inner beauty and character.
 
• Other options ("**personality**", "**style**", "**exterior**") do not convey the idea of inner beauty as effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**within**'.

 

Complete Passage: * Appearances may not reveal the man. So, you shouldn't make judgments about a man's character based on how he looks__. People smile and smile, yet prove to be __deceitful__. On the other hand, people with rough exteriors prove to be the __kindest__ and most considerate people on earth. They are the people who are beautiful from __within__. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Personality (व्यक्तित्व): Though it relates to character, it does not fit as well as "within" to emphasize inner beauty.
 
• Style (शैली): Refers to manner or fashion, which is not relevant to the context of inner beauty.
 
• Exterior (बाहरी): Refers to the outer surface, which is the opposite of what the passage intends to convey.
